scope: Historical commands from the iPhone preview run. Device identifiers and local build paths have been replaced with variables; these are templates, not verbatim logs.
evidence_policy: Raw originals, including failures, are retained under ignored tests/reports/local/2026-09-22/. Native screenshot bundles remain in ignored tests/reports/v3/native-* directories. These paths are local-only, not published artifacts.

template_variables.DEVICE_ID: An explicitly selected, trusted physical iPhone.
template_variables.BUILD_ROOT: A local build directory chosen by the developer.

commands.command_template: xcodebuild -project LightPlan.xcodeproj -scheme LightPlan -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ${BUILD_ROOT} CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
xcodebuild -project LightPlan.xcodeproj -scheme LightPlan -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ${BUILD_ROOT}-Signed CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
bash -n scripts/run_iphone.sh; bash scripts/run_iphone.sh --help; git diff --check
commands.local_evidence: Shell syntax, usage and whitespace checks passed.

commands.command_template: xcrun devicectl device process launch --device ${DEVICE_ID} --timeout 20 com.arenovo.lightplan
